text:
anya: Heads up — HF->Redwood conversion left special tokens only in tokenizer_config.json. slow (Python) tokenizer ends up with no bos/eos and our chat templates break on canary. Repro steps below.

matt: Can you paste a minimal repro and which model?

anya: Model: `hf-internal/instr-lite-3b` converted with our `convert_hf.sh` v2. Repro: `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path, use_fast=False)` then `print(tokenizer.special_tokens_map)` -> `{}`. Meanwhile `tokenizer_config.json` contains `{"bos_token":"<s>","eos_token":"</s>","unk_token":"<unk>"}`.

chen: This is the tokenjson vs tokenizer_config mismatch — fast tokenizers write `tokenizer.json` (tokenizers lib) while slow/legacy code reads `tokenizer_config.json`/attrs. If conversion only wrote specials to tokenizer_config.json but didn't populate tokenizer.json metadata, you get divergent behavior.

anya: Exactly. Canary logs showed system prompt missing leading <s>, so prompts concat wrong and rouge/bleu in quant evals tanked. Seen on 3 canary runs.

sofia: Quick mitigation: patch the conversion to mirror special tokens into both `tokenizer.json` and `tokenizer_config.json` and reserialize slow/fast artifacts. Add a post-convert check `ensure_specials_present()` that loads both and asserts parity. I'll open a PR.

jax: Also add an onboarding unit test that does: `for use_fast in (True,False): t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path, use_fast=use_fast); assert t.bos_token is not None`. Fail the pipeline if it fails.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: ONB-4123 — "tokenizer special tokens not mirrored into tokenizer.json" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ONB-4123 :white_check_mark:

matt: For existing converted models in the registry we should run a remediation job to patch artifacts. Scan says ~24 affected models. Who can run the job?

chen: I can run a one-off patch job. Will do a dry-run first and post list. Need S3 keys + approval to write. ETA ~2h.

anya: Great — after patching let's re-run canary + quantization evals for the affected models. Tagging @sofia for PR review and @matt for canary gating.

sofia: :thumbsup: Reviewing the PR now. Add changelog + migration note to the onboarding docs. Also proposing a lint: fail conversion if `tokenizer_config.json` exists without `tokenizer.json` (or vice versa).

matt: Also add a small script in infra to scan new HF uploads for this mismatch and send an alert. We don't want this to regress.

anya: Logged followups in ONB-4123. After fix I'll requeue the 3 failing canaries and post results here.

chen: Dry-run results (summary): 24 candidates found, 18 actually missing `tokenizer.json` specials. Will share S3 paths shortly.

anya: Thanks — keeping this high priority since it blocks the quantization batch tomorrow.
